ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Windows Defender Registry Key Tampering Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to tamper with different Windows Defender registry keys in order to disable some important features related to protection and detection

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\ Security\\ Center.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*"))) AND (((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*d\\ 0.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*DisallowExploitProtectionOverride.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*EnableControlledFolderAccess.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MpEnablePus.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*PUAProtection.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SpynetReporting.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SubmitSamplesConsent.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TamperProtection.*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*d\\ 1.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableAccess.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableAntiSpyware.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableAntiSpywareRealtimeProtection.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableAntiVirus.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableAntiVirusSignatures.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableArchiveScanning.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableBehaviorMonitoring.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableBlockAtFirstSeen.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableCloudProtection.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableConfig.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableEnhancedNotifications.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableIOAVProtection.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableNetworkProtection.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableOnAccessProtection.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisablePrivacyMode.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableRealtimeMonitoring.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableRoutinelyTakingAction.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableScriptScanning.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisableSecurityCenter.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Notification\\_Suppress.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SignatureDisableUpdateOnStartupWithoutEngine.*"))))
